description: Under a parallel workspace run (cargo test --workspace --all-targets -- --skip matrix::), fixture_matrix's harness tests fixture_readiness_drains_an_exited_child and fixture_command_verdict_follows_the_fixture_expectation failed once with 'Operation not permitted (os error 1)' from kill_process_group -> libc::kill(-pgid, SIGKILL). EPERM from kill(-pgid) means a process group with that id exists but is not ours: the child had exited and its pgid was reused by another process group, so the harness sent SIGKILL toward a group it does not own. Both pass in isolation (3/3 re-runs, 30 passed). Fix: the harness only signals a group whose leader it still holds un-reaped (kill before wait, or track the group's liveness), and a failed kill is loud only when the group is ours. Done when a test forces the exited-child path and the harness never calls kill on a reaped child's pgid.
title: The fixture harness signals only a process group it owns
